title: Considerations about the in situ derivatization and fractionation of EFA and NEFA in biological and food samples
author: Pimentel, Fontes, et al.
materials: The derivatization performance for TG-C13 and FFA-C19 was above the 95% without statistical differences for the utilization of KOH or MetNa as base-catalyst (data not shown). Furthermore, FAME-C13 was not detected in the NEFAME extracts in none of the assayed samples.

steps.title: Add internal standards
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of TG standard (1.3 mg/mL) and 100 µL of FFA standard (1.3 mg/mL) into a heat‑resistant glass tube with a cap.

steps.title: Add sample and solvents
steps.instruction: Add the sample (5–10 mg oil or 250 µL plasma/milk) to the tube, then add 2 mL methanol and 4 mL hexane.

steps.title: Vortex and warm
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture for 30 s and warm at 40 °C in a dry‑block.

steps.title: Add MetNa and react
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL MetNa (2.5 M); the reaction starts immediately, vortex frequently and keep the reaction time ≤ 3–4 min.

steps.title: Quench reaction
steps.instruction: Stop the reaction by adding 230 µL 3 M H₂SO₄ in methanol.

steps.title: Cool and separate layers
steps.instruction: Cool the tube on ice, then centrifuge at 1250 g for 5 min at 25 °C to separate the organic layer.

steps.title: Collect EFAME and add FAME standard
steps.instruction: Transfer 3–3.5 mL of the upper hexane layer to a 15 mL Falcon tube, evaporate to dryness, resuspend to a suitable volume and add 100 µL FAME standard (1.3 mg/mL).

steps.title: Remove residual hexane and add water
steps.instruction: Evaporate any remaining hexane, add 250–500 µL water, and evaporate again; avoid pooling to prevent methanol carry‑over.

steps.title: Wash reaction medium
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL hexane, vortex 30 s, centrifuge at 1250 g for 5 min at 25 °C, and discard the organic phase.

steps.title: Esterify NEFA
steps.instruction: Add 1.25 mL DMF and 1.25 mL 3 M H₂SO₄, vortex frequently, and incubate at 40–50 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Extract NEFAME
steps.instruction: Cool on ice, add 2–4 mL hexane, vortex 30 s, centrifuge at 1250 g for 5 min at 25 °C to isolate the NEFAME layer.

steps.title: Finalize NEFAME extract
steps.instruction: Collect an appropriate volume of the upper layer, evaporate to dryness with a gentle nitrogen stream if needed, redissolve in a suitable solvent, and add 100 µL FAME standard (1.3 mg/mL) in a vial.
